title: CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP privilege use
hypothesis: A process was spawned with a privilege token it shouldn't have.
queries: DeviceEvents | where ActionType == 'ProcessStart' | where InitiatingProcessPrivileges contains 'SeDebugPrivilege' or 'SeImpersonatePrivilege'
rationale: SeDebug/SeImpersonate are the classic potato-chain enabling privileges.
